units.title: Practice of Drafting Techniques
topics: 1.1. Practice drafting techniques by using the drafting instruments like drawing board, parallel scale, adjustable setsquares, compass, different grade of pencils, rubber, clips, clutch pencils, scales, stencils, inking pens, circle templates, French curves etc. Unit: II Geometrical Constructions
2.1. Draw a perpendicular to a given line with different conditions.
2.2. Draw a line through a given point parallel to a given straight line.
2.3. Divide a given straight line into any number of equal parts by various methods.
2.4. Trisect the given right angle.
2.5. Construction of different types of regular polygons given the length of a side.

2.6. Construct an ellipse by concentric method, arcs of Basic Architectural Drawing Course Code:C4315002 NITTTR Bhopal – GTU - COGC-2021 Curriculum Topics and Sub-topics circles method, oblong method, and loop & thread method. Unit: III Lines, lettering and dimensioning
3.1. Types of lines and intensities of lines.
3.2. Lettering including single stroke letters and Gothic letters
3.3. Dimensioning terms and annotations, placing of dimension and unit of dimensions in drawings. Unit: IV Orthographic Projections
4.1. Theory of projections such as object projectors, planes of projections (views), direction of vision
4.2. Identify the quadrant in which the object is located
4.3. Projection of points, lines when placed in various positions with respect to H.P & V.P.
4.4. Projection of planes when placed in various position with respect to H.P. & V.P
4.5. Orthographic Projection of objects , given a pictorial (isometric) view in the first angle method
uos: 1.a. Use various types of drafting instruments associated with the drafting techniques
